build_optimizer: build an optimizer from config using build_optimizer_mapper with a PyTorch model and d2go config
get_param_groups: get optimizer parameter groups for a model with learning rate and weight decay settings from config
register_optimizer_mapper: register a new optimizer builder function in the D2GO_OPTIM_MAPPER_REGISTRY for custom optimizer support
add_gradient_clipping: add full model gradient clipping to an optimizer by wrapping it with maybe_add_gradient_clipping
get_lr_param_groups: get learning rate parameter groups for a model with bias lr factor and lr multiplier overwrite settings
